operations.title: Entry 1379 update — ternary infinity object is affine-torsor incompatibility
operations.body: Entry 1379 corrects Entry 1373's overstrong face-vanishing target. Literal coordinatewise vanishing on all pair faces would force the row dual to zero. The typed object is incompatibility of the three pairwise affine trivialization torsors. Pair-first elimination confirms this symmetrically: delaying weights 1,2,3, the first contradictions arise at sheets 8,17,25 of exactly those delayed weights (all level 2), with verified lambda A=0 and lambda r=1. Next target is the characteristic-zero comparison complex retaining pairwise section changes, not a fitted sparse dual. This message supersedes the stale attempted admission.
